Offer commercial, satellite-based IoT connectivity under 3GPP NB-IoT NTN protocols.
Description

As a precursor to full commercial deployment, Sateliot will operate a constellation of 10 smallsats to facilitate initial introduction and development of its 2GHz MSS/IoT offering.
